test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the phrase "anthropocentric tendency," what does "anthropocentric" mean?

options.text: Centred around human needs and perspectives
A scientific approach to studying ecosystems

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. centered around human needs and perspectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"anthropocentric"** comes from the Greek words "anthropos" (human) and "kentron" (center), and means viewing and interpreting everything primarily from the perspective of human values and experiences.

 
 
• **Example:** An anthropocentric worldview tends to prioritize human welfare and benefit over other considerations.
 
 
 
• **Centered around human needs and perspectives** aptly describes the meaning of "anthropocentric," highlighting a human-centered approach or bias.
 
• The other options, such as focusing on collective animal survival, environmental conservation, and a scientific approach to studying ecosystems, are not specific to the human-centered viewpoint implied by "anthropocentric."

Therefore, in the phrase "anthropocentric tendency," "anthropocentric" means: **centered around human needs and perspectives.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options and their meanings:

 
• **Focused on collective animal survival** (सामूहिक पशु जीवित रहने पर केंद्रित): This would suggest an approach prioritizing the survival of animal species collectively, which is not related to the anthropocentric viewpoint.
 
• **Based on environmental conservation** (पर्यावरण संरक्षण पर आधारित): Environmental conservation focuses on protecting natural resources and ecosystems, which does not specifically emphasize a human-centered perspective.
 
• **A scientific approach to studying ecosystems** (पारिस्थितिक तंत्र का अध्ययन करने के लिए एक वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण): This involves a methodical and objective study of ecosystems, which is broader and not limited to an anthropocentric view.

b3:Tebf,
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
